get_crops_scale: compute pre-crop, scale factor, and post-crop values for an Aria camera given width, height, cam name, and down_scale
rescale_camera_tw: rescale a CameraTW tensor by applying pre-crop, down-scale factor, and post-crop for a given Aria camera
rescale_calib: rescale raw fisheye camera calibration parameters by applying crop offsets and dividing focal length by the down-scale factor
rescale_image: downscale a numpy image array using cv2 INTER_AREA interpolation with optional pre-crop and post-crop for Aria cameras
rescale_image_tensor: downscale a PyTorch image tensor using torchvision resize with configurable interpolation mode and optional pre-crop and post-crop
